updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
Release 3.1.3.6
- OpenKneeboard OUT now groups keywords in row-across format to keep similar commands at the top.
- OpenKneeboard OUT F-4E keywords now have phase-of-flight handling based on last sent command.
- OpenKneeboard OUT pages refresh on any passed command without requiring the Page command.
- Added WSO commands for fuel management, tanker/airfield divert, plus display support.
- Added WSO commands Radar Lock Target and Radar Focus Target [1-20] to OpenKneeboard commands list.
- Added plugin controls for OpenKneeboard OUT tab browsing for use in Voice Attack "execute an external plugin command".
- Added WSO VAICOM custom mod "Shutdown" Boots performs switching in WSO station and secures his systems during shutdown.
- Added WSO custom mod "Radar Alt Monitor" set altitude and Boots calls out when descending 20 ft RA below requested altitude.
- Added VAICOM mods section to Jester wheel under Crew Contract. (Jet needs to be running to display)
- Fixed F-14 AIRIO file swapping and Jester Enable checkbox behaviour.
- Fixed AIRIO commands incorrectly requiring recipient on ICS Hot Mic.
- VAICOM F-4E WSO VAICOM F-4E WSO.vap now refreshes on every startup.
- OKB OUT now accepts user-selected port (requires OpenKneeboard restart).
